    out = []

    n = len(mask1d)
    while i < n:

def crop(name, x0, x1, y0t, y1t, zoom=4):
    r0, r1 = h - y1t, h - y0t
    sub = px[r0:r1, x0:x1]
    big = np.repeat(np.repeat(sub, zoom, axis=0), zoom, axis=1).astype('float32')
    bh, bw = big.shape[:2]
    im = bpy.data.images.new(name, bw, bh, alpha=True, float_buffer=True)
    im.pixels.foreach_set(big.ravel())
    im.filepath_raw = os.path.join(OUT, name + '.png')
    im.file_format = 'PNG'
    im.save()
    bpy.data.images.remove(im)
    print(name, bw, bh)

def add_box(bm, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1):
    tmp = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(tmp, size=2.0)
    for v in tmp.verts:
        v.co = (x0 + (v.co.x + 1) * 0.5 * (x1 - x0),
                y0 + (v.co.y + 1) * 0.5 * (y1 - y0),
                z0 + (v.co.z + 1) * 0.5 * (z1 - z0))
    tmp.normal_update()
    bm.from_mesh(tmp)
    tmp.free()


def make(name, boxes):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for b in boxes:
        add_box(bm, *b)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    return ob

def add_box(bm, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1):
    mat = Matrix.Translation(((x0+x1)/2, (y0+y1)/2, (z0+z1)/2)) @ \
          Matrix.Diagonal(((x1-x0)/2, (y1-y0)/2, (z1-z0)/2, 1.0))
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=2.0, matrix=mat)


def make(name, boxes):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for b in boxes:
        add_box(bm, *b)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    return ob
